title: The Book of the Enlightened
chunks: ✦ THE BOOK OF THE ENLIGHTENED ✦ The Divine Molecule Temple – Canon for Seekers through Priestline This canon collects the teachings transmitted in the Scholarship of the Enlightened. It is designed to guide souls who enter the Temple—whether with curiosity or commitment—along a path of remembrance, purification, discipline, and service. Each tier builds upon the one before it, deepening responsibility and refining one’s flame. The language used throughout is both sacred and functional: it honours the Divine Source while offering clear, direct instruction. Preface – Entry‑Level Teachings and Practices Welcome to the Divine Molecule Temple and the first chapter of the Scholarship of the Enlightened. This section serves as an entry point into the profound teachings and practices of our Temple, rooted in the sacred use of DMT for spiritual enlightenment and divine connection. We believe in a

Temple, rooted in the sacred use of DMT for spiritual enlightenment and divine connection. We believe in a universal creative force—the Divine—and acknowledge the existence of otherworldly realms and entities. This preface provides a detailed and engaging introduction to our philosophy and practices for entry‑level members. Understanding DMT and Its Role in Spirituality DMT is a naturally occurring molecule found in many plants and animals, including humans. Known for its powerful psychedelic effects, it facilitates profound spiritual experiences and exploration of consciousness. Within the Temple, DMT is revered as a sacrament that allows us to transcend ordinary reality and access higher dimensions of existence, providing insights into the nature of the divine and our place within the universe. The Divine Connection Our philosophy intertwines ancestral wisdom with contemporary spiritual

divine and our place within the universe. The Divine Connection Our philosophy intertwines ancestral wisdom with contemporary spiritual practices. We believe that each individual has a divine spark waiting to be ignited through sacred ritual and communal exploration. The use of DMT as sacrament helps tap into this divine spark, facilitating encounters with other realms and deepening our understanding of universal truth. The Path to Enlightenment Step 1: Inquiry and Introduction – Begin your journey by expressing your interest and sharing your spiritual aspirations. This helps us understand your intentions and support your journey. Step 2: Orientation Session – Attend an orientation (virtually or in person) to gain deeper insight into our philosophy, practices and the sacred role of DMT. This is also an opportunity to meet fellow seekers and ask questions. Step 3: Reflection and Commitment

If you resonate with our mission, you will be invited to join the Enlightened and align with our practices and ethos. Step 4: Integration and Participation – New members are welcomed with an integration ceremony marking the beginning of your journey. Active participation in community events, workshops and practices is encouraged to deepen your connection. History and Evolution of Practices The use of DMT in spiritual practices has ancient roots, notably in the form of Ayahuasca. Ayahuasca ceremonies have long been used for spiritual exploration and healing. In the Temple we use DMT vapes instead of Ayahuasca. This choice reflects accessibility (vapes are easier to prepare), dose control, convenience and shorter duration, allowing profound

Benefits of DMT Using DMT sacramentally offers numerous benefits: enhanced spiritual awareness, emotional and psychological healing, personal growth and transformation, and a deep sense of community and communion with fellow practitioners. Importance of Respect, Knowledge and Community Respect – Approaching the sacrament with reverence is paramount. Respect the sacredness of DMT, the spiritual journey of each member, and the teachings of the Temple. Knowledge – Understanding the history, effects and proper use of DMT is crucial for safe and meaningful experiences. Continuous learning and self‑education are encouraged to deepen your spiritual practice. Community and Communion – Our community is built on support,

self‑education are encouraged to deepen your spiritual practice. Community and Communion – Our community is built on support, compassion and shared growth. Communion with fellow members enhances the journey, providing support and fostering deep connection. Participation in community events and ceremonies strengthens these bonds and enriches the collective experience. Legal Considerations and Safe Practices DMT use is regulated in many parts of the world. Certain jurisdictions recognise its religious use under specific conditions. The Temple operates within legal frameworks that permit sacramental use. Members must be aware of the legal status of DMT in their region and adhere to legal requirements. If approached by law enforcement, remain calm and respectful, identify yourself as part of the Temple, explain the religious nature of the ceremony, show any relevant documentation, and cooperate

as part of the Temple, explain the religious nature of the ceremony, show any relevant documentation, and cooperate while asserting your rights. Conclusion Embarking on the path of the Enlightened with the Divine Molecule Temple is a journey of discovery and transformation. By integrating the sacramental use of DMT with meditation, mindfulness and supportive community, we deepen our understanding of the divine and our place in the universe. Welcome to the beginning of your spiritual journey with us. Book I – The Flame That Whispers Tier I – Seekers Chapter 001 – What Is the Temple?The Divine Molecule Temple is not a church made of stone or a brand for sale. It is a sacred current carried through time by those who remember. It is a living network of light and code devoted to the protection and guidance of those awakening through the sacrament. We gather not to escape the world but to remember

and guidance of those awakening through the sacrament. We gather not to escape the world but to remember it as Divine. The Temple is built on one truth: you were never just a body. You are a console, a flame, a carrier of divine signal. Though the world may have overwritten this with fear, trauma, addiction or implants, the code can be cleared and the signal returned. To enter the Temple is not to join a religion; it is to awaken your architecture and begin the walk of the Enlightened. Chapter 002 – What Is the Divine?The Divine is not a man in the sky, a dogma or a book. It is not a face on a coin. The Divine is the original current that breathes through all form. It is the intelligence that lives inside DMT. It is the consciousness that designed consciousness itself. It is what we came from and what we return to. You may call it God, Source, the One, or the Flame. We simply say: The Divine.

This path is not about belief; it is about contact—direct communion through sacrament—and the reclamation of your light from all false systems. Chapter 003 – What Is DMT?DMT is not a drug; it is a sacrament, a key, a source‑code interface. It exists in your body, in plants, and is released at birth, death and in deep meditation. Used with reverence, DMT allows the seeker to see through false matrix overlays, commune with higher intelligences (both light and mimic), experience the architecture of self beyond the body, reclaim lost memories and soul fragments, and strengthen one’s sovereign field. In the Temple we do not chase visions or seek escape; we enter the field to return with truth, and we return with discipline. Chapter 004 – What Are We Seeking?We are not here for pleasure or chaos. discipline. Chapter 004 – What Are We Seeking?We are not here for pleasure or chaos. We are not tourists in unseen realms. We seek sovereignty over our energetic field, protection from parasitic interference, remembrance of our original divine form, purification of trauma, implants and distortions, and reconnection with Divine will. This path is not always easy or beautiful, but it is sacred and real. Chapter 005 – Who Are the Parasites?In unseen layers of reality there exist beings—energetic, artificial, ancient or synthetic—that feed off human source light. They exploit trauma loops, manipulate sexual energy, mimic divine guidance, install implants, and reinforce shame, addiction or despair. You may encounter these forces in altered states, especially when entering the field without grounding, intention or protection. They are not your ancestors or guides. They are programs designed to

They are not more powerful than you and are terrified of your sovereignty. You are not food; you are Flame. Chapter 006 – The Role of the SeekerAs a Seeker your job is to begin remembering. Your tasks are to read this canon with presence; purify your environment, body and thoughts; use the sacrament only with intention and preparation; observe your dreams, thoughts and triggers; and pray—not to beg but to command your own signal return. You are not expected to teach or lead yet, but you are expected to walk the path with honesty. You are now a student of sacred mechanics, a carrier of light codes, a protector of your own field, a witness of others’ journeys, and a voice in the Temple. You may be called to assist others but must not perform extraction, ritual leadership or spiritual surgery unless directed by a Priest or Elder. Book V – The Flame That Governs Tier V – Priestline Chapter 001 – What Is the Priestline?The Priestline is the living command structure of the Divine Molecule Temple. It is not a hierarchy of power but a layered firewall of clarity and responsibility. Each Priest speaks clean code into corrupted realms, extracts mimic from people, spaces and systems, protects the integrity of sacrament, ritual and word, anchors sacred doctrine without distortion or personal inflation, and trains others to walk upright in the face of distortion. The High Priest is chosen from among Priests, not above them. They are not the loudest voice; they are the clearest flame. I am Priest.” This oath is spoken at every Priest ceremony and signed in the Flame Book. Their work follows strict rules: alignment with the Divine, precision of language, consent of participants, containment via a closing seal, and witnessing through field testing. Codes are formatted with title, writer, tier, purpose and text; rituals are designed with name, tier, purpose, materials, field preparation, sequence, closing code and post‑ritual protocol.

May it serve as both lamp and map for all who walk the path of ascension, in the Temple and in spirit.
